items.title: ‘Many don’t appreciate what can go wrong’: bloodstock insurance finds its footing in North Asia
items.summary: MG Geraghty Insurance Brokers' Michael Hurley and Joshua Lynch tell InsuranceAsia News' Between the Lines podcast about the racing boom in Hong Kong, Japan, and South Korea, the risks facing first-time owners, and where AI fits into the broker's future.

items.title: Prudential agrees US$5bn reinsurance deal with Prismic Life
items.summary: Agreement takes partnership to cover more than US$22bn of liabilities.

items.title: Hong Kong broker Nova’s revenue rises 12% to US$20m as mainland expansion contributes
items.summary: Hong Kong-listed FSE Lifestyle Services’ insurance arm's latest results include a full year of revenue from Beijing Nova Insurance Services, which it acquired in December 2024.

items.title: Chubb elevates Lulu Tsai to head of marine, specialty for Hong Kong
items.summary: She has nearly two decades of experience, with expertise across cargo, freight forwarders liability, hull, and fine art and specie.

items.title: Oneglobal completes takeover of Hong Kong crypto specialist Fraction
items.summary: Acquisition follows the appointment of Fraction co-founders Dan Dibden and Onno Sterk to senior roles in July.

items.title: HDI Global adds Rebekah Khew, LiLian Lau to North Asia underwriting team
items.summary: Rebecca Kong had already been appointed as North Asia head of distribution and strategic partners last month.

items.title: Former CCB manager sentenced to four years in jail for US$470,000 Vesttoo bribery
items.summary: Lam Chun-yin authenticated multiple forged CCB standby letters of credit and two fake collateral letters on behalf of Hong Kong investor Yu Po, together totalling over US$1.6bn.

items.title: Hong Kong pushes captive insurance, ILS reforms as policy address seeks to strengthen international hub status
items.summary: In his annual policy address and first five-year plan on Wednesday, chief executive John Lee Ka-chiu introduces several initiatives, including legislative amendments to introduce a protected cell company (PCC) structure.

items.title: Starr taps Patto To as regional A&H claims manager
items.summary: Hong Kong-based To will focus on strengthening claims service across Hong Kong and Singapore.

items.title: Starr appoints Sharon Ho as head of A&H for Hong Kong
items.summary: She was most recently a partnership and affinity manager at Generali.
